first_build_goal: Test whether long-lived wrapping projectiles remain readable tactical assets instead of becoming visual noise.
Test whether Redirect and Split feel understandable and useful when applied to an already-living projectile.

include.wave_roster: Wave2 fixed spawn schedule: 4 Chasers + 3 Drifters

not_now: Wave1 and Wave3 as playable content
Merge as a required player-facing decision

must_work.text: Rule simulation advances on the fixed 60Hz clock independent from render FPS.
must_work.check: debug_step(1.0) advances exactly 60 ticks and produces deterministic snapshot.

must_work.text: Cast Bolt costs one mana, obeys 0.35s cooldown and cap8 rejection is no-cost.
must_work.check: cast fixture compares mana/projectile count before and after valid/invalid cast.

must_work.text: Projectile wraps at arena edges without resetting its 18s lifetime.
must_work.check: x=.99 heading0 stepped .1s -> x=.012 and lifetime17.9 within tolerance.

must_work.text: Mana regenerates one every 4.0s up to4.
must_work.check: mana2 + debug_step(8.0) with no casts -> mana4.

must_work.text: Redirect rotates a contacted projectile exactly +90° clockwise and consumes charge only on hit.
Split preserves parent and creates one child at deterministic ±30° with inherited state; cap8 failure is no-cost.
must_work.check: split fixtures test cross-product sign and cap boundary.

must_work.text: Merge rule kernel is deterministic even though Merge is not required in the playable slice.
must_work.check: two normal bolts at headings0/30 merge to heading15, damage2, lifetime16; empowered cannot remerge.

must_work.text: Wave2 spawns exactly 7 enemies on the frozen 0..9.6s schedule with frozen archetype stats.
must_work.check: step across spawn boundaries and compare enemy list/spawn cursor.

must_work.text: Enemy contact costs one HP then grants 1.0s invulnerability; HP0 fails the run.
must_work.check: contact fixture tests repeated overlap inside/outside invulnerability.

must_work.text: Pause freezes simulation and Retry restores the fixed Wave2 initial state.
must_work.check: snapshot stays identical during Pause and equals initial snapshot after Retry.
